bio.text: David Borrero represents District 111 in the Florida House of Representatives as a Republican, elected in 2020 and reelected subsequently.
Borrero is an attorney who lives in Hialeah. Borrero was born in Queens, New York, and moved to Florida in 2004.
Borrero holds a B.A. in political science and economics (2012) and an MBA from Florida International University, and a J.D. from St. Thomas University School of Law.
